text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, I decided 
to stop by the zoo with Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The zoo—it's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I don't... dislike it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese macaque. ――A snow monkey, 
huh."

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: Giiih! Kiiieeeh!! KIIIEEEEEEEEEEEKKK!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Why—are you so excited?

text_block_list.name: Animal-Savvy Old Man
text_block_list.text:
This is... a cry to warn the herd of 
danger... It's as if I've returned to the 
wild...!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Daddy, why are all the tigers sleeping 
with their bellies showing?

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't understand... Even Dad doesn't 
understand...

text_block_list.name: Lion
text_block_list.text: (Tremble, tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every animal either fled the moment 
Symboli Kris S drew near, or submitted 
completely. This continued until—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"It seems... that I am causing... 
...stress... to the animals."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Should I... head back?
choice_data_list:
If you go all out with kindness, your 
feelings might just get through.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Our feelings... will reach them? 
Specifically—... what should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle!)
Kyupiii---k!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, an unfamiliar animal burst 
vigorously out from the depths of the 
bushes.

text_block_list.name: Park PA
text_block_list.text:
"—An announcement for all park guests. A 
red panda has currently escaped— —We 
sincerely apologize for the 
inconvenience—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ ――I will follow... your 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Not—scared. Not—the enemy.

text_block_list.name: Red Panda
text_block_list.text: !? Eeeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's alright—there's no need—to be afraid. 
—I am—on—your side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――You understand, don't you? Clever as you 
are. That you should not... run away. 
Listen to... what I have to say――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I should... listen quietly, they say.

text_block_list.name: Red Panda
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, feeling reassured (?), the red 
panda offered no resistance 
whatsoever—resting obediently in Symboli 
Kris S's arms.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —She, too, made it back home safely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――It was all thanks to... your advice.
choice_data_list: Did my feelings get through... I wonder?
Maybe I was still a little scared.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That child too— in the end—fell 
asleep in my arms.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So that is... MAGOKORO... I have 
learned... something new.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It looked less like she was sleeping 
and more like she had passed out, but I 
decided not to bring it up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. As expected—it is not—easy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Be my sparring partner... please.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Not—scared— Not—the enemy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer, I understand Symboli Kris 
S's personality. And yet... even so, I 
felt like rolling over and waving the 
white flag."
